title: Всё больше и всё меньше
description: Всё больше и всё меньше: применяем правило в новых ситуациях, разбираем словарь, диалог и авторский текст без аудирования.
objectives: Описывать изменение с more and more
notes: More and more people означает растущее количество людей.
Colder and colder или more and more difficult описывает изменение признака, а не только два фиксированных объекта.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: As winter approached, the evenings became ___.
exercises.explanation: С коротким прилагательным повторяется сравнительная степень colder.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: more / most.

public_payload.sentence: More and ___ visitors are using the online form.

exercises.editorial_answer: More and more visitors are using the online form.
exercises.explanation: More and more обозначает рост числа посетителей.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Инструкции становились всё более подробными.»
exercises.editorial_answer: The instructions became more and more detailed.
exercises.explanation: More and more detailed описывает изменение степени признака.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: The queue became more longer and longer.

accepted: The queue became longer and longer.

exercises.reference_answer: The queue became longer and longer.
exercises.incorrect_answer: The queue became more longer and longer.
exercises.editorial_answer: The queue became longer and longer.
exercises.explanation: Longer уже сравнительная степень, лишнее more убирается.

public_payload.passage: At first, only a few neighbours used the shared tool cupboard. Over several months, more and more people began borrowing equipment. The organiser added clearer labels and a booking sheet. As use increased, keeping track of returns became more and more important. The group did not assume that growth alone proved the system worked well; it also checked whether borrowed tools came back on time.

options.label: Fewer and fewer tools were ever available, according to the text.
More people began using the cupboard.

exercises.editorial_answer: More people began using the cupboard.
exercises.explanation: More and more people прямо описывает рост использования.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: gradually — постепенно; increase — увеличиваться; decrease — уменьшаться; trend — тенденция
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: gradually — постепенно; increase — увеличиваться; decrease — уменьшаться; trend — тенденция.

exercises.prompt: Что ещё проверяла группа помимо роста?

public_payload.passage: At first, only a few neighbours used the shared tool cupboard. Over several months, more and more people began borrowing equipment. The organiser added clearer labels and a booking sheet. As use increased, keeping track of returns became more and more important. The group did not assume that growth alone proved the system worked well; it also checked whether borrowed tools came back on time.

options.label: Whether tools were returned on time.
Only whether the cupboard was fashionable.

exercises.editorial_answer: Whether tools were returned on time.
exercises.explanation: Рост числа пользователей не заменил проверку возвратов.

options.label: It is becoming most and more difficult.
It is becoming more and more difficult.

exercises.editorial_answer: It is becoming more and more difficult.
exercises.explanation: More and more difficult — правильная модель.

public_payload.sentence: A general direction of change over time is a ___.

exercises.explanation: Trend — тенденция, а не единичный случай.
